title: non-zero total_discount_fee and the principal that includes it (detail read-back)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture wc-discount-nonzero (GET /working-capital-loans/2, tenant gerege, business date 2026-09-03): the balance read-back of a facility disbursed on a product whose discount is 37.53 MNT, the FIRST committed observation of a non-zero totalDiscountFee. STORED cells: balance.totalDiscountFee=37.53 -> "3753", balance.principal=1037.53 -> "103753". The oracle's applyDisbursement sets totalDiscountFee = product.discount and principal = disbursedAmount + discount [WorkingCapitalLoanBalance.java:115-120], so principal includes the discount: 1000 disbursed + 37.53 = 1037.53 exactly. balance.totalDisbursement=0.0 -> "0" (Fineract does not move this column on the disbursement write path). DERIVED cells (the port's balance getters): balance.unrealizedIncomeFromDiscountFee = max(37.53 - 0 - 0, 0) = 37.53 -> "3753" (the clamp's first non-zero operand; the max floor itself is still ungraded because both other operands are 0 — see .softhouse/findings/F-2026-09-10-workingcapital-discount-fee-graded.md), balance.principalOutstanding=1037.53 -> "103753", balance.totalExpectedRepayment=1037.53 -> "103753", balance.totalOutstanding=1037.53 -> "103753", balance.totalRepayment=0.0 -> "0". WHAT THIS VECTOR DISCRIMINATES: a disbursement port that sets principal to the disbursed amount ALONE, dropping the discount the oracle adds (registered as workingcapital-wrong-discount-dropped-from-principal); every earlier captured balance carried totalDiscountFee 0, so the dropped add changed nothing and no vector could see it. Structural: expect.detail.id="2", status="loanStatusType.active", status_id="300" (stored m_wc_loan.loan_status_id, active=true), and the draw recorded one tranche of 1000 (principal/actualAmount 1000 -> "100000"). All money cells are transcribed as integer minor units; no cell is computed here.

provenance.note: Every expect field is transcribed from the committed capture wc-loan-discount-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the discounted facility whose balance block is read back.
